# Fox.glb

`Fox.glb` is the Fox sample from KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets, `Models/Fox/glTF-Binary/Fox.glb`
(https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/main/Models/Fox), copied unchanged.

- Low poly fox model by PixelMannen: CC0 1.0.
- Rigging and animation by @tomkranis on Sketchfab: CC-BY 4.0
  (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
- glTF conversion by @AsoboStudio and @scurest.

It is a skinned glTF whose primitive has no NORMAL attribute and no indices, with three named clips
(Survey, Walk, Run).
